title: XRECORD OBJECTS allocation rollback and retry
scope: Sweep allocations reached while dx_iface emits a bounded direct NOD-to-XRECORD graph from its OBJECTS callback, checking whole-output rollback and same-adapter retry.

source.profile: AC1027 ASCII and Binary DXF output with one NOD hard-owner entry and one typed XRECORD containing a single group-1 payload.

method.calibration: For each output encoding, perform one successful export with a high allocation countdown armed at entry to dx_iface::writeObjects; compute the number of reached allocations from the remaining countdown.
method.injection: For every calibrated offset, seed the destination with a sentinel, create a fresh source model and adapter, inject one allocation failure during writeObjects, and let fileExport unwind through its staged-output transaction.
method.rollback: Require export refusal, callback entry, exactly one injected allocation failure, byte-for-byte preservation of the destination sentinel, and unchanged source NOD/XRECORD handles, owner link, and payload.
method.retry: Disable injection and export again with the same adapter and source model; fresh-import the output and verify the NOD entry resolves to exactly the typed XRECORD with the expected owner and payload.

results.readback: NOD hard-owner entry, remapped XRECORD identity, parent owner, and group-1 payload match

qualificationLimits: This covers only the generated direct NOD-to-XRECORD emitter and enclosing DXF publication transaction; other OBJECTS builders and whole-drawing failure states remain open.
The input is a locally authored model, not an independent producer file.
No physical source, native XRECORD semantics, or format-support claim is qualified.
